== Trivia ==
* The phrase "for great justice" comes from the English (European) translation of the video game [[w:Zero_Wing|Zero Wing]], which is also the source of the [["Make Your Time!"]] skill name and the "[[w:All your base are belong to us|All your base are belong to us]]" phrase.
